thread.title: Apple stock-option traders aren't expecting a blow-out, or blow-up earnings report - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple stock-option traders aren't expecting a blow-out, or blow-up earnings report - MarketWatch
text:
Traders of Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.04% stock options don't seem to expect a blow-out, or a blow-up stock reaction to the technology behemoth's fiscal fourth-quarter earnings report , due out after Thursday's close. An options strategy known as a straddle, which involves the simultaneous buying of bullish and bearish stock options at the current price, with expiry Friday, are priced for a 5.0% move in either direction on Friday. That's barely above the above the average one-day post-earnings move of 4.5% over the past five years. The media move has been 4.3%. During the past 20 quarters, the stock rose 11 times the day after earnings for an average gain of 4.9%, while it fell an average of 4.0% the nine times it declined. Apple's stock was up 0.1% ahead of earnings. It has gained 8.7% over the past three months while the Nasdaq Composite COMP, +1.21% has shed 4.3% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.86% has slipped 0.1%.
